sources.title: Azure Key Vault service limits
sources.contentRelevance: Current vault-resource quotas: 4,000 other transactions and collective 300 CREATE secret/IMPORT certificate/IMPORT key per 10 seconds; subscription limit five times per vault. Backup bound 500 versions, no individual-version deletion, same-subscription/geography restoration. Managed HSM has separate limits.
